item.title: VP Radhakrishnan enjoys shikara ride on Dal Lake in Srinagar
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 26: Vice President C P Radhakrishnan on Thursday enjoyed a shikara ride on the iconic Dal Lake, describing the experience as a glimpse of Srinagar’s timeless charm and natural beauty. Radhakrishnan arrived here on Wednesday evening on his maiden visit to the Kashmir valley. item.title: Young generation will progress when nation is strong: LG Sinha
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 26 : Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha on Thursday said nation-building must be the top priority of the young generation as they will progress when the country is strong. item.title: CM Omar Abdullah to Attend Ranji Trophy Final in Hubballi
item.description: Srinagar,Feb 27: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah is scheduled to travel to Hubballi in Karnataka on Friday to watch the Ranji Trophy final between Jammu and Kashmir and Karnataka, official sources said. Sources said that the chief minister is expected to reach Hubballi later in the day and attend the summit clash of the Ranji Trophy from the stands. item.title: Driver Killed, One Injured as Chicken-Laden Truck Falls into Gorge in Ramban
item.description: Ramban, Feb 27: A truck driver lost his life while another person sustained injuries after a poultry-laden vehicle plunged into a deep gorge in Ramban district of Jammu and Kashmir late Thursday night, officials said. The accident occurred on a hilly stretch of road in the district when the truck, reportedly carrying chickens, skidded off the roadway and fell into a gorge. item.title: Mughal Road Reopens for Traffic, LMVs Ply Smoothly
item.description: Shopian, Feb 27: The historic Mughal Road was reopened for traffic on Friday after remaining closed due to recent snowfall, with Light Motor Vehicles allowed to ply smoothly along the stretch. Officials said the strategic road connecting Shopian in South Kashmir with Poonch in the Jammu region was thrown open following clearance operations carried out by the concerned agencies. item.title: Ranji Trophy: Jammu and Kashmir create history, clinch trophy for the first time.
item.description: Jammu,Feb 28 : Jammu and Kashmir created history on Saturday by winning their maiden Ranji Trophy, defeating eight-time champions Karnataka in a drawn final courtesy of a dominant first-innings lead.
